title: BSU teachers took part in the international conference dedicated to the 25th anniversary of the SCO

blocks.text: July 4, 2025 teachers of the Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasayev took part in the international scientific and practical conference “Shanghai Spirit: Bridges of Mutually Beneficial Cooperation and Sustainable Development within the SCO”. The conference was
dedicated to the 25th anniversary of the founding of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO).

The purpose of the conference was to strengthen the role of the expert community in understanding current international processes, as well as to develop practical recommendations for strengthening the strategic partnership between the Kyrgyz Republic and the People's Republic of China within the SCO. The conference contributed to strengthening mutual trust, developing humanitarian ties and promoting the values that underlie the "Shanghai spirit".

The conference was attended by Liu Jiangping, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the PRC to the Kyrgyz Republic, A. B. Baetov, Minister of Justice of the Kyrgyz Republic, Director of the National Institute of Strategic Initiatives under the President of the Kyrgyz Republic, M. O. Abakirov, Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic, as well as representatives of government bodies, the diplomatic corps, scientific and expert circles, the business community, and international analysts.
